title: George Augustine's role in the Sonny South band
summary: Turner says Augustine was the original Sonny South man, possibly its manager, and that Richard McNeil came after him.

blocks.x: What did George Augustine have to do with it?

Well at the time, see I don't know whether he was managing the band at the time, that he talked to me or not, but he had something to do with it I know. But he was the original Sonny South. He died too.
I see, but they had another guitar player in there when you were with the Sonny South. Yeah, Richard McLean. No, I played with George and Wilde, you see.
I got confused on that one.
